brief:
A child has died from lead poisoning in Gaza, according to Maan Wire. The death marks a documented case of lead toxicity in the enclave, where contamination from munitions and degraded infrastructure has raised health concerns among medical professionals and aid organizations.

Lead exposure remains a persistent problem in Gaza's population, particularly among children exposed to pollutants from years of conflict and deteriorating sanitation systems.
title: Child dies from lead poisoning in Gaza Strip
